# Name: # Dual-boot layout for 16 MB flash boards (LilyGo T-Embed CC1101).
#   factory = this ESP32 Flipper Zero port
#   ota_0   = Bruce
#   otadata = which of the two the bootloader starts (8 KB)
# otadata is the whole dual-boot mechanism: the ROM bootloader reads it before
# touching either app. Empty or corrupt means "boot factory"
# never-written otadata always lands back on this firmware. Bruce's "Flipper
# Zero" main menu item wipes it
# nvs keeps the exact offset/size it has always had (0x9000 / 0x6000) so its
# contents are not shifted. Note the merged flash image still pads over it with
# 0xFF
Type: so a full merged flash clears settings and BT bonds either way.

# Name: # Bootloader occupies 0x0..0x8000 on the ESP32-S3
# 0x8000 (CONFIG_PARTITION_TABLE_OFFSET); the first partition follows at 0x9000.
# Partitions must be listed in ascending offset order
# before the apps -- which is why factory starts at 0x20000 rather than 0x10000.
# App partitions must be 64 KB aligned.
# 5 MB per app against a 2.99 MB image today. The 5.75 MB tail is `spiffs`
# which Bruce mounts as its LittleFS storage; this port does not touch it
# the table is shared by both firmwares
Type: so it is declared here too. Bruce's

# Name: # copy of this table is custom_16Mb_dualboot.csv -- keep the two identical.
nvs
phy_init
otadata
factory
ota_0
coredump
